notes.title: Update for Oct 10th, 2020
notes.content:
The developer is monitoring all the comments coming in across both the Steam and Switch versions and is making changes. Some of them will take a little longer to implement so we will share news about it as they come close to being pushed. In the mean time they wanted to pass on what is in today's update...

changelog:

- Fixed several errors in the texts
- Fixed a graphical bug when using the black hole and teleportation powers simultaneously
- Adjustments to game balance
- Various fixes and optimizations of the physics engine
- Fixed a problem that could lead to obtaining additional rank point in the introductory level
- Correction of the language choice menu which should appear in the first part

Please visit the games community forums and let us know your thoughts and ideas!
